description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the LeaveTypeDao class within the orangehrmLeavePlugin, specifically testing CRUD operations, search functionalities, and list retrieval of LeaveType entities in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests various methods of the LeaveTypeDao class including retrieval, creation, deletion, and search functionalities for LeaveType entities

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the DAO object, and populates test data from fixture files

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the getLeaveTypeList method by comparing the retrieved list against expected data

methods.name: _getLeaveTypeObjectWithValues

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests that saving a LeaveType returns an object with the expected properties and ID

methods.name: testSaveLeaveTypeCheckSavedType
methods.description: Ensures that the saved LeaveType has the correct name and is not marked as deleted

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue
methods.description: Tests the deleteLeaveType method's return value for specified IDs

methods.name: testDeleteLeaveTypeList

methods.description: Asserts that the number of deleted leave types matches the expected count

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListInverseResult

methods.name: testGetDeletedLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Validates the IDs and names of the leave types in the deleted list are as expected and ordered correctly

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeReturnValue

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeValues

methods.name: testUndeleteLeaveTypeList

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByNameValues

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdObjectWrongArgument

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeByIdValues

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListObjectTypes
methods.description: Confirms all items in getLeaveTypeList are instances of LeaveType

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListCount

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListInverseResult
methods.description: Checks that the list does not contain leave types with certain IDs or names

methods.name: testGetLeaveTypeListValuesAndOrder
methods.description: Validates the IDs and names of leave types in their returned order
